Stovepipe Recordings: Impressed

Impressed": Natalya Sokolova sends her regards Features NATALYA SOKOLOVA. Contains 1 dialogue exchanges. [1]

Manny, you really do have an eye for talent. First Schaeffer, then Lewis and Wally. Imagine my surprise when I discovered you even managed to recruit Vik. I thought you hated him after what happened at Odea, but here you are, welcoming old enemies into your house and giving them the literal keys to the Castle. I haven't decided if you're a genius with boundless empathy or a moron who actually believes that people can change. People don't change. Most of the time, if you think someone has changed it's because you never really saw them. You never look close enough to see if the person staring back at you is genuine or is hiding their true intentions. That's why you're so easy to fool. And why I will always be two steps ahead of you. [1]

I have the Black Tusk, the real True Sons, and the Hunters at my disposal, while your agent have civilians chasing water bottles. [1]

Impressed": Natalya Sokolova sends her regards Features NATALYA SOKOLOVA, VIKRAM MALIK. Contains 2 dialogue exchanges. [1]

When you're ready to surrender, I would be more than happy to reunite you two love birds. I hear stress can do terrible things to a pregnancy, especially in older women. Manny, if you really do love her, you might want to hurry. Oh, and Agent, I hope to see you soon. [1]

Numbers

Washington, D.C. BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: Permission denied. MORT "CURSED" KELLOGG: Why? BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: Worried I'll draw too much attention. Need to stay on mission. Worried that I'll get distracted or something. Who knows. MORT "CURSED" KELLOGG: That's too bad. I was really looking forward to meeting ya. BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: Me too. Is it true you were stationed at Germany when this all went down? MORT "CURSED" KELLOGG: It is. BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: You ever see combat before this? MORT "CURSED" KELLOGG: I've been deployed. BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: What's your number? MORT "CURSED" KELLOGG: Before this? Um...twenty or thirty. After fifty, I stopped counting. BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: Really? MORT "CURSED" KELLOGG: Yeah, too hard to keep track. [1]

BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: Not for me. MORT "CURSED" KELLOGG: What's your number? BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: 372. MORT "CURSED" KELLOGG: We're you deployed before this? BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: Nope. Went through basic and joined the guard, but never got to see any reaction until the JTF was activated. MORT "CURSED" KELLOGG: 372 kills this year. That's impressive. BEATRICE "AUNTIE" KAPLAN: 371... actually. [1]
